## Summary

```text
investigation/
├── summary-grouping-share-bughunt-2026-11-02.md
└── 2026-11-02-summary-grouping-share-bug-hunt/
    ├── summary/   populated dots forwarding
    ├── grouping/  fixed-key overlap preflight
    ├── share/     visible lookup rebinding
    └── backend/   native DuckDB visible denominators
```

Record four independently reproduced P2 findings as #1138, #1139, #1140 and #1141, all labelled bug and ready-for-agent with no blockers. This PR records investigation and tickets; it does not repair those findings.

## Evidence

- **Before:** remaining contract violations reproduced on fetched main `978d7bef4247bf1348af5b90bfab47924db25500`, after comparison with the October 29–31 investigations and closed reports.
  **After:** minimized red-capable replays, independent controls, row-level matrices, environment and evidence hashes retained at `7e3d004e95f69641f4a3179ecfacd705f326b0ed`. The findings remain reproducible.
- Local selector matrix: 432 divergences and 45 passing controls; Grouping preflight: 130 calls; share rebinding: 120 missing refusals and 216 passing controls.
- SQL share matrix: 96 calls / 128 share columns, 32 native mismatches and 64 portable matches; 112 typed-key calls and 198 special-name calls provide bounded additional coverage.
- Source Review-ready passed all five required checks for the final SHA. Package build/check, complete suite and snapshots omitted for this research-only diff.
- [Verification record](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/pull/1142#issuecomment-6571982173).
- [Standards / Spec review record](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/pull/1142#issuecomment-6571982992): Standards 0; Spec 1 P3, resolved and checked in the prose follow-up.
- Fetched main remained `978d7bef4247bf1348af5b90bfab47924db25500`; the prospective merge was clean and introduced no interacting main changes.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

The research commit can be reverted. The four implementation tickets remain open.

**Blast Radius:** research

Only dated notes and standalone investigation evidence changed; package behavior and generation inputs are unaffected. CI monitoring was outside the request.

## Standards

Zero findings: zero documented-rule violations and zero actionable heuristic smells. The review checked the new Markdown and R harnesses against the investigation conventions, domain vocabulary, relevant ADRs and the repository's *Answering a review* policy. The dated notes preserved earlier investigations, separated evidence from current decisions and bounded their callback/backend/version claims. All 54 evidence hashes and the reported CSV counts agreed.

## Spec

One P3 finding against the requirement to record the investigation accurately: the exact Total-share value asserted in two notes and issue #1141 did not match the retained final replay. The numerical bug and displayed-row oracle remained valid.

**Disposition:** accepted. Follow-up commit `7e3d004e95f69641f4a3179ecfacd705f326b0ed` deleted the unsupported exact-value assertion and refreshed the corresponding manifest hash. The original Spec reviewer checked precisely that correction against the retained logs and confirmed resolution. Issue #1141 was corrected and its evidence link updated to the follow-up SHA; the published body was read back and verified.

No other missing requirement, scope creep or erroneous evidence conclusion was found. The four issues matched the requested targets and were independently actionable. Package implementation and package tests were untouched.

## Follow-up boundary

The follow-up changed prose and one evidence hash only. It introduced no executable behavior outside the first review, so the correction was verified directly rather than rerunning the complete review or investigation matrices. The first snapshot's history and record remain explicit.

Standards: 0 findings. Spec: 1 finding, resolved. Final submitted SHA: `7e3d004e95f69641f4a3179ecfacd705f326b0ed`.
